composition_label: Customer insights -> Ticket triage & routing -> Semantic search

construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation authored for this build; no other builds read or copied

shared_schema.input: Object: schema_version=1, fixture_label (nonblank provenance label), feedback list of {id, customer_id, source, text}; optional queries list of {text, limit=5}; optional config object
shared_schema.output: Validated shared envelope preserving input with normalized config/queries, status=ok, stage=semantic, insights, triage and semantic results
shared_schema.validation: One shared validation layer checks schema, nonblank text, unique identities, routes, configuration, referential integrity, stage ordering, theme evidence, ticket propagation and indexed/ranked result references. Unknown fields are rejected.
shared_schema.error: CLI file, JSON and validation errors produce one JSON object with status=error, error message, and exit code 2

cross_stage_handoffs.data: Validated per-feedback theme IDs, sentiment and evidence-backed theme actions; triage preserves customer, source and original text

Validated accountable tickets become indexed documents; searchable text includes original feedback, category, priority, team, owner, theme labels and recommended actions. Hits preserve ticket metadata.

behavior.insights: Configurable multi-label phrase matching with synonym normalization; unmatched feedback grouped by corpus document-frequency topic token, excluding stopwords and sentiment words, with deterministic alphabetical tie-break or other fallback. Themes include unique customer evidence, feedback counts, heuristic sentiment and actions.
behavior.triage: One ticket per feedback item. First category rule matching any theme ID or keyword phrase wins; otherwise default route. Priority rules can escalate but never downgrade route priority. Every route requires accountable team and owner.
behavior.semantic: In-memory inverted index with synonym-expanded normalized tokens and log-TF/IDF cosine ranking. Positive scores only, rounded to 8 decimals; ties by ticket ID. Unknown lexical queries return no hits. Per-query limit 1..100.
behavior.embedding_interface: Library run(payload, embedder=callable) optionally accepts embedder(text)->nonempty finite nonzero numeric list, fixed dimensions across documents and queries. Hybrid score is 65% lexical plus 35% nonnegative cosine. Synthetic callable tests only; no live embeddings or LLM.
behavior.configuration: Provided config keys replace the corresponding default section, not individual rules. Keys: theme_rules, category_rules, priority_rules, default_route, synonyms. Custom theme IDs must not start with inferred:. Changing themes requires matching category theme references.
behavior.determinism: No clocks, randomness, external calls or mutable global state; injected callable is expected to be deterministic. Input is deep-copied. Empty feedback and empty query lists are valid.

included: Integrated bounded pipeline and JSON CLI
Local semantic approximation via synonyms with optional injected dense embeddings
excluded: Live model providers, networks and external dependencies
Persistence, external ticket creation and product catalog ingestion
Authentication, enterprise deployment, monitoring and large-scale indexing
LLM generation or automatic action execution

test_outcomes.cli_stdout: Exactly one valid JSON object; status=ok; stage=semantic
test_outcomes.coverage: Each stage, cross-stage metadata/actions, custom rules, evidence integrity, priority escalation, unknown topics, empty input, synonym relevance, score ties, optional synthetic embeddings, invalid embeddings, malformed schemas, invalid configuration and CLI success/error behavior
